page_convention: PDF physical page, one-based, not journal page

records.observation: Meals; two supplied options; eight concepts and 24 intermixed questions.
Each concept has pre-test, intervention and subsequent unaided post-test.
Within-person condition assignment; AI is simulated and always correct.
AI trials lack correctness feedback; non-AI baselines differ in feedback content.
Update records an initial choice, then permits revision after advice.
Update learning versus minimal feedback: Z=0.71, nonsignificant; r=0.04.
Explanation-only learning exceeds minimal feedback; not significantly different from explanation-feedback.
Long-term learning unmeasured; deeper cognitive engagement is an interpretation.
Provided binary alternatives do not establish self-generated alternatives.
Reported age ranges include minors; not an adult-only sample.

records.locator: PDF p.2 Introduction, p.6 Table1, p.8 §5.3.1; arXivv1 same sections
records.observation: Replication counts conflict: 300 in introduction/source row; 270 in n row/results.
Learning uses normalized post/pre change; recommendation designs occur in separate experiments.
